title: commitwork failure-taxonomy prose overlay
description: Sentences of monitor/failure-taxonomy.json as they were written, each paired with the public text that names a capability instead of a product. Keyed by record (doc, class:<id>, remediation:<title> and the like). mergeProseOverlay() in bin/taxonomy-render.mjs applies it and checks the same shape by hand: a pair whose public text does not occur exactly once in its record refuses. The real overlay is private (monitor/private/taxonomy-prose.json or CW_TAXONOMY_PROSE); monitor/taxonomy-prose.example.json shows the shape.
